## 更新内容 / Changes

适配 Codex 桌面版 `26.1103.60933` 的 Rspack 分块页面结构。页面语言、普通 / Fast 和 Ultra 推理现在按实际模块能力独立检测并注入；Fast 仅对本地 API 身份补充权限入口，仍遵循服务商返回的 Fast / Ultra Fast 要求。Ultra 适配保留模型自身公布的推理等级，并验证对应 catalogue 与保存门禁。客户端结构无法唯一确认时继续使用官方原页面。

Updated the Codex desktop `26.1103.60933` Rspack-split renderer. Locale, Standard / Fast, and Ultra reasoning are detected and injected against their actual modules. Fast adds an access path only for local API identities and still respects provider Fast / Ultra Fast requirements. Ultra preserves each model's advertised reasoning levels and verifies the related catalogue and persistence gates. If a client structure cannot be identified unambiguously, the official page remains unchanged.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。有运行实例时，关闭窗口或普通退出会保留后台服务；请完成任务、等待实例结束且管理器彻底退出后再安装新版。账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Closing the window or using ordinary Quit keeps background services alive while instances are running. Finish active work and wait for the instances and manager to exit completely before installing an update. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

支持范围不变：Codex 桌面 / CLI 与已验证的 macOS Claude Code CLI。Codex 桌面菜单适配依赖已验证的客户端结构；模型和服务商仍决定 Fast / Ultra 请求是否可用。本版本在隔离的本地 loopback 服务上验证 UI 交互与请求路由，不代表真实付费账号、服务商额度或所有模型均已端到端验收。

Supported clients are unchanged: Codex desktop / CLI and the verified macOS Claude Code CLI. Codex desktop menu adaptation depends on a verified client structure; model and provider capabilities still determine whether Fast / Ultra requests are available. This release verifies UI interaction and request routing against an isolated local loopback service; it does not claim end-to-end validation with a paid account, provider quota, or every model.

## 验证来源 / Verification

已在 macOS 上使用已安装的 Codex `26.1103.60933` 做隔离桌面烟测：验证页面切换到中文、普通与 Fast 请求（Fast 发送 `priority`）、Ultra 选择及发送，并在重新载入后确认 Ultra 设置恢复。Ultra 请求与同一客户端内未修改的 Codex CLI 原生 Ultra 请求进行对照。源码回归、完整 TypeScript 测试、Go sidecar 测试和打包验收在发布流程中执行；最终来源以 `v0.15.29` tag 及其成功的 GitHub Actions Release run 为准。校验清单：`https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/releases/download/v0.15.29/SHA256SUMS.txt`。

An isolated desktop smoke test on macOS used the installed Codex `26.1103.60933`. It verified the Chinese page, Standard and Fast requests (Fast sent `priority`), Ultra selection and submission, and restoration of Ultra after reload. The Ultra request was compared with an unmodified native Ultra request from the bundled Codex CLI. Source regressions, the full TypeScript suite, Go sidecar tests and packaging checks run in the release workflow; the authoritative source is the `v0.15.29` tag and its successful GitHub Actions release run. Checksum manifest: `https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/releases/download/v0.15.29/SHA256SUMS.txt`.
